description: word-spacing adds space after every space.

florui.css: .p { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; word-spacing: 30px; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chrome 155 on Windows: 7.03% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. With the property ignored the same fixture measures 18.8% and the box is 90px too narrow, so it fails.
